Short title and commencement

SINDH SERVICE TRIBUNAL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH SERVICE TRIBUNAL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh
Service Tribunals Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 29th January, 1997]
No. S.Legis.l(2)/97, dated 29‑1‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh
Service Tribunal (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Act XV of 1973

SINDH SERVICE TRIBUNAL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH SERVICE TRIBUNAL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh
Service Tribunals Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 29th January, 1997]
No. S.Legis.l(2)/97, dated 29‑1‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Sindh Act XV of 1973.‑‑In the Sindh Service Tribunal Act, 1973,
in section 3, for subsection (4‑A), the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"4.A.
Notwithstanding anything contained in subsection (4), Government may, not later
than 15th February, 1997, curtail the term of office of the Chairman or any
Member appointed before the commencement of this Ordinance."
